title: •Precise Hit
caption: •Precise Hit (V)
game_text:
USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-{permanent-weapon} weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner’s Used Pile.
LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.
